source.selection: one building row plus its two buildingSourceKey-bound floor surfaces

derivationContract.pivotXZ: arithmetic mean of the four public footprint vertices
derivationContract.longAxis: normalized mean of edge p0->p1 and reversed opposing edge p3->p2
derivationContract.yawDeg: atan2(longAxis.x,longAxis.z), because authored +X forward maps to EFT +Z at zero yaw
derivationContract.lengthM: mean length of the two opposing long edges
derivationContract.widthM: mean length of the two opposing short edges
